messages:
maria: Hey sec team — quick ping. I opened a PR that changes how the auth proxy handles KMS calls in onprem setups and also tweaks VPC egress ip-table rules. It may widen the service account scope a bit. Can someone take a quick look before I try to merge on Friday? PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4821 :eyes:

devon: linking here — does this touch token-projection or SA token volumes?

maria: No token-projection changes, but we do add a new env var for KMS proxy endpoint and remove the old shared secret. Diff snippet:
```yaml
env: 
  - name: KMS_PROXY_URL
    value: https://kms-proxy.internal.svc
  - name: LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET
    value: "" # removed, will use KMS wrap/unlock
serviceAccount: inference-worker-sa  # unchanged name, but we add iam:roles/crypto.access in deploy config
```

sam: quick question — the deploy config you mentioned, is that in infra/helm/values.yaml? if so can you paste the exact iam binding?

maria: yes infra/helm/values.yaml, binding is added under extraIamBindings: 
```yaml
- role: roles/crypto.access
  members:
    - serviceAccount:project:inference-worker-sa
```

jess: Thanks for the context. Initial notes: 1) SA scope increase = risk. We prefer narrow role scoped to specific KMS keys rather than a broad roles/crypto.* role. 2) VPC egress rule changes — need an egress IP allowlist and justification in the PR description. 3) remove LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET looks good for secret minimization, but we need a migration plan + audit events showing key unwraps. Please add: - a scoped IAM role (custom role) or resource-level binding - a migration runbook (how to rotate and revoke old secret) - unit/e2e test that exercises the new KMS path
I'll add `sec/review-needed` label and request an architecture review if you can't scope the role.

elaine: platform note — we can schedule a canary on one region after the change. If you expose KMS_PROXY_URL only within the VPC and use a private DNS entry that's best.

security-bot: automated-scan: secret-scanner=PASS; iam-risk=MEDIUM (serviceAccount binding to roles/crypto.access); public-ips-exposed=NO; repo-sbom=OK 

maria: great actionable items, thanks. I'll: 1) replace role with a custom role scoped to the kms key resource, 2) add migration runbook in the PR, 3) add the canary steps and DNS note. Will ping again when updated. :thumbsup:

jess: sounds good. ping me once the custom role and runbook are in place and I'll do final check. If you need quick help drafting the least-privilege role, @jess can share a template.

maria: will do — thank you all!
